mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% (as of t-1mo) indicates aggressive monetary accommodation that reduces equity discount rates and lifts S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days, with evidence from FEDFUNDS at 0.07%.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% (as of t-1mo) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 and industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 (as of t-1mo) indicate robust consumer demand and production capacity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST>1400 and INDPRO>105 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 3.5%), declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and retail sales (RSAFS < 600000) signal supply chain disruption and falling consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL inflation > 3.5%, INDPRO < 100, and RSAFS < 600000.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 0.5% (as of t-1mo) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost household income and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index exceeding 265 (as of t-1mo) signals accelerating inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 265.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent GDP growth (GDPC1 > 18700) and housing starts (HOUST > 1400) indicate robust economic expansion that increases corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1>18700 and HOUST>1400 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high-interest-rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), rising CPIAUCSL (CPIAUCSL > 265) signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity risk appetite and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 265.
